body:
## What it does

A weekday executive assistant: it reads everything first, answers staff questions from a written playbook, and posts the client call notes so you start the day already briefed. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @LoganARobison shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
